text: T129 is blocked: BLOCKED on the user: the Mac screen is LOCKED (ioreg IOConsoleUsers CGSSessionScreenIsLocked = true; HID idle about 35 min; display was asleep, power state 0). Inferred cause of the phase-1 hang: macOS treats every window as occluded while locked, and WebKit then stops requestAnimationFrame and throttles timers (App Nap). Evidence from two instrumented SCRATCH builds (scratchpad copy, own target dir, shared tree untouched): (1) closing More right after the page toggle does NOT help, so the open More popover is ruled out; (2) bar 970 px, labels false, 0 data-labels flips, so the U6 label-threshold relayout loop is ruled out; viewport width steady 970/970. What the marks show instead: the 40 ms page-count loop runs at 40 ms for 4 ticks, then degrades to about 1000 ms per tick, then stops, and Page count stays 'Section page 1 of 1' although the paragraph already paginates -- the page count is set inside a requestAnimationFrame callback (Writer.tsx measure effect, unchanged from HEAD), so rAF never fired. That is the signature of an occluded/hidden WKWebView, not a busy loop. Chromium (not occluded) is fine. A rerun with caffeinate -d -u (display on, power state 4) still hung, consistent with the lock screen, not display sleep, being what occludes the window. native-reliability passes while locked because it never waits on rAF-driven layout. Not proven: needs one native-smoke run with the screen UNLOCKED and the app window visible. TO UNBLOCK: the user unlocks the Mac and stays at it (or keeps it unlocked and awake) while a worker runs python3 scripts/native-smoke.py on a quiet machine. If it then passes, close T129 as environmental and note that native smoke and screenshot runs need an unlocked, visible session. If it still hangs, reopen: the next suspects are wave-2 page-view CSS (editor.css +91 lines) or FootnoteArea/useFootnoteLayout, bisected in a scratch copy. Logs: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/t128/smoke.log and smoke-awake.log; scratch experiment logs in the worker scratchpad pw129/smoke1.log and smoke2.log.
resolution: Owner Mac unlocked 2026-10-27 ~20:55 EDT; coordinator ran python3 scripts/native-smoke.py on a quiet machine with the current smoke binary (built 06:11, newer than every src edit; includes U1-U19). Result: PASSED, exit 0, all three phases -- phase 1 incl. native WebKit page fragmentation/pagination and acknowledged native checkpoint; phase 2 acknowledged SQLite checkpoint before deliberate kill; phase 3 forced restart recovered the journaled edit + snapshot restoration. Log: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/t129-owner/smoke.log. Conclusion: the T129 hang was environmental (locked screen throttles WKWebView requestAnimationFrame); the earlier checkpoint/journaled mismatch did not recur.
